description: List the videos in a video surface, in play order: id, position, label, name, url, content type, size and duration. Omit `surface_slug` for the workspace's first video surface. Viewer role required.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

name: list_videos
